name: sema
description: Sema is a semantic governance layer for AI agents operating live software, workflows, documents, and operational systems.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-force-exit testes/unidade/**/*.test.ts testes/integracao/**/*.test.ts
scripts.cli:instalar-local: npm run build && node scripts/garantir-path-cli-windows.mjs && npm link --workspace @semacode/cli
scripts.cli:empacotar: npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('.tmp/pacotes',{recursive:true})" && npm pack --workspace @semacode/cli --pack-destination ./.tmp/pacotes
scripts.cli:empacotar-runtime: npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('.tmp/pacotes',{recursive:true})" && npm pack --workspace @semacode/cli --pack-destination ./.tmp/pacotes
scripts.release:verificar-publica: npm run repo:verificar-publico && npm run build && npm run cli:testar-pacote-publico
scripts.release:preparar-publica: npm run cli:empacotar-publica && npm run cli:testar-pacote-publico
scripts.ia:sync-entrypoints: npm run build && node pacotes/cli/dist/index.js sync-ai-entrypoints --json
scripts.docs:prepare: npm run status:sync && npm run status:check
scripts.project:check: npm run status:check && npm run repo:verificar-publico && npm test && npm run format:check && npm run cli:testar-runtime && node pacotes/cli/dist/index.js verificar . --saida ./.tmp/verificacao-project-check
